verdicts.reason: The two candidates use almost the same layout, and both share the same faults. The centred GROVE wordmark sits over a left-aligned headline and body copy, while the badges and CTA are pushed to the right edge, so the elements have no common alignment axis. The BACK BY DEMAND and SUMMER ONLY pills nearly touch each other and are crammed right under the body copy. B moves the whole stack lower, which leaves a thinner bottom margin under the CTA (about 38px against about 53px) and a tighter gap between the copy and the badges, so A is slightly better balanced.
